results.title: Ship It: Idle Dev Tycoon: The idle game where App Review can reject you | Product Hunt
results.content:
Hey Product Hunt!  
  
I work with app developers all day, and I wanted a game about what that job actually feels like. So Ship It is an idle tycoon where you start with one developer in a tiny office, ship updates, and slowly build a studio. Along the way, things go wrong the way they do in real life: servers go down on a Friday, an SDK gets sunset, and App Review rejects your build when the tech debt gets out of hand  
  
Version 2.0 just went live. It adds an App Review mechanic, incidents, a Hall of Fame that carries across studio sales, and a Game Center leaderboard for your lifetime fortune  
  
There are also 68 collectible advisers. Some of them might look a little familiar if you spend time on tech Twitter :) [...] Subscribe

## Hypership requests [...] It's free on iPhone, and you can play the whole game without paying. Payments run on RevenueCat, which is where I work. I built it with a lot of help from @Claude by Anthropic, @ChatGPT by OpenAI , @RevenueCat , @Supabase and Pixellab, as well as playtesting by @thomas\_petit1 , @drbarnard , @hannahparvaz , and many more  
  
If you've ever shipped an app, I'd love to hear which part of the job should become the next incident. Let me know :)
